spatial_transform: Full original 224x224 image, 2x nearest-neighbor upscale; labels outside the image.
timing: 25 fps at every 20 native 0.002 s steps on the common swing-start clock, starting at t=0. Each arm stops being captured at its own exact first floor/object contact. Between-tick contact appears on the next video tick (less than 40 ms later); shorter arm holds. After both contacts, hold 30 additional frames (1.2 s). No temporal interpolation or retiming.
physics: Unchanged archived Roller2Dof.throw(prop, snapped_action, seed=411, render=True). Read-only mj_step observer; original function continues unchanged to return its contact and flight. No additional mj_forward, control, geometry, camera or dynamics changes. Goal appended only to mjvScene using exact exporter geometry and color.
asset_resolution: Unmodified archived scene tar extracted to isolated temporary storage; only gripper.HERE and MENAGERIE_DIR redirected to its legitimate assets.
evidence: Actual native simulator cube and gripper, not reconstructed animation. Archived snapped policy actions; no new inference. Full native raw and goal contact PNGs match saved contact pixels bit-exactly before lossy H.264 encoding.
